chapterInfo.content:
6
Yeriko tua
1Na Yeriko deɛ, na wɔato mu na wɔabram ano Israelfoɔ no anim. Obi mfiri adi, na obi mma mu. 2Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ: Hwɛ, mede Yeriko ne ne hene ne akofoɔ no mahyɛ wo nsa. 3Na montwa kuro no ho nhyia; akofoɔ no nyinaa ntwa ho nhyia prɛko. Saa ara na yɛ no nnansia. 4#Lew 25.9 Na asɔfoɔ baason nkurakura osebɔ ntotorobɛnto nson mfa nni adaka no anim, na ɛda a ɛtɔ so nson no, montwa kuro no ho nhyia mprɛnson, na asɔfoɔ no nhyɛne ntotorobɛnto no. 5Na sɛ wɔhyɛne osebɔ abɛn no na mote totorobɛnto no nne a, ɔman no nyinaa nhuro mmɔ ose kɛseɛ, na kuro no ho fasuo no bɛhwe fam tim, na ɔman no mforo nkɔ wɔn anim tee. 6Na Nun ba Yosua frɛfrɛɛ asɔfoɔ no, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Monsoa apam adaka no, na asɔfoɔ baason nkurakura osebɔ ntotorobɛnto nni AWURADE adaka no anim. 7Na wɔka kyerɛɛ ɔman no sɛ: Monsene nkɔtwa kuro no ho nhyia, na wɔn a wɔamia no nsene nni AWURADE adaka no anim.
8Na Yosua ka kyerɛɛ ɔman no no, asɔfoɔ baason a wɔkurakura osebɔ ntotorobɛnto no sene dii AWURADE anim na wɔhyɛnee ntotorobɛnto no, na AWURADE apam adaka no dii wɔn akyi. 9Na wɔn a wɔamia no dii asɔfoɔ a wɔhyɛne ntotorobɛnto no anim, na kyidɔm no dii adaka no akyi; wɔnam na wɔrehyɛne ntotorobɛnto no ara. 10Na ɔman no deɛ, Yosua hyɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Mommmɔ ose, na mommma wɔnnte mo nne, na asɛm biara mmfiri mo anomu de kɔsi da a mɛse mo sɛ mommɔ ose no ansa na moabɔ ose. 11Na AWURADE adaka no twaa kuro no ho hyiaa prɛko, na wɔbaa nsraban mu bɛdaa hɔ.
12Na Yosua sɔree anɔpahema, na asɔfoɔ no soaa AWURADE adaka no. 13Na asɔfoɔ baason no kurakura osebɔ ntotorobɛnto nson no de di AWURADE adaka no anim, wɔnam na wɔrehyɛne ntotorobɛnto no ara, na wɔn a wɔamia no dii wɔn anim, na kyidɔm no dii AWURADE adaka no akyi, wɔnam na wɔrehyɛne ntotorobɛnto no. 14Na da a ɛtɔ so mmienu no, wɔtwaa kuro no ho hyiaa prɛko, na wɔsane baa nsraban no mu. Wɔyɛɛ saa nnansia.
15Na da a ɛtɔ so nson no, adeɛ rekye pɛ, na wɔtuaa nhema sɔree ntɛm, na wɔtwaa kuro no ho hyiaa saa ara mprɛnson; da no nko ara na wɔtwaa kuro no ho hyiaa mprɛnson. 16Na ɛbaa sɛ deɛ ɛtɔ so nson no soɔ a asɔfoɔ no rehyɛne ntotorobɛnto no no, Yosua ka kyerɛɛ ɔman no sɛ: Mommɔ ose, ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE de kuro no ama mo. 17#Num 21.2; Yos 2.12-13; Heb 11.31 Na kuro no nyɛ ahyiradeɛ, ɛno ne emu ade nyinaa mma AWURADE; odwamamfoɔ Rahab nko ara na ɔnnya nkwa, ɔno ne wɔn a wɔwɔ ne nkyɛn ne ne fie nyinaa, ɛfiri sɛ ɔno na ɔde abɔfoɔ a yɛsomaa wɔn no huntaeɛ. 18#Lew 27.28; Deut 13.18 Mo ho yie ara na monhwɛ ahyiradeɛ no ho, na moanhyira so na moamfa ahyiradeɛ no bi, na moamfa Israel nsraban no anyɛ ahyiradeɛ amma amaneɛ amma so. 19Na dwetɛ ne sika, ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ ne dadeɛ nnoɔma nyinaa nyɛ kronkron mma AWURADE, na wɔmfa mmra AWURADE adekorabea. 20#Heb 11.30 Ɛnna ɔman no bɔɔ ose na wɔhyɛnee ntotorobɛnto no. Na ɛbaa sɛ ɔman no tee ntotorobɛnto no nne no, ɔman no huro bɔɔ ose kɛseɛ, na ɔfasuo no hwee fam tim, na ɔman no foro kɔɔ kuro no mu, wɔn nyinaa kɔɔ wɔn anim tee, na wɔfaa kuro no. 21Na wɔde nkrantɛ ano sɛee deɛ ɛwɔ kuro no mu nyinaa pasapasa, mmarima ne mmaa, mmɔfra ne mpanin, anantwie ne nnwan ne mfunumu.
22 # Yos 2.14 Na mmarima baanu a wɔkɔsraa asase no deɛ, Yosua ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Monkɔ ɔbaa dwamamfoɔ no fie nkɔfa ɔbaa no ne deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa mfiri hɔ, sɛdeɛ mokaa no ntam no. 23#Num 31.19 Na mmeranteɛ akwansrafoɔ no kɔe, na wɔde Rahab ne n’agya ne ne na ne ne nuanom ne deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa firi bae, na wɔde n’abusua nyinaa firii adi bɛgyaa wɔn Israel nsraban no akyi. 24Na kuro no deɛ, wɔde ogya hyee ɛne deɛ ɛwɔ mu nyinaa. Emu dwetɛ ne sika, ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ ne dadeɛ nnoɔma nko na wɔde bɛguu AWURADE fie adekorabea no mu. 25#Mat 1.5; Ate 1.25 Na odwamamfoɔ Rahab ne n’agya fie ne deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa deɛ, Yosua gyee wɔn nkwa, na ɔtenaa Israel mu de bɛsi nnɛ, ɛfiri sɛ ɔde abɔfoɔ a Yosua soma maa wɔkɔsraa Yeriko no huntae.
26 # 1 Ah 16.34 Na Yosua kaa ntam saa berɛ no sɛ:
Nnome nka onipa a ɔbɛsɔre
abɛkyekyere Yeriko kuro yi, AWURADE anim:
Ɔde n’abakan na ɛbɛhyɛ aseɛ,
na ɔde ne ba akumaa na ɛbɛsisi ano apono.
27Na AWURADE dii Yosua akyi, na wɔtee ne nka asase no nyinaa so.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na Yeriko deɛ, na wɔato mu na wɔabram ano Israelfoɔ no anim. Obi mfiri adi, na obi mma mu. Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ: Hwɛ, mede Yeriko ne ne hene ne akofoɔ no mahyɛ wo nsa. Na montwa kuro no ho nhyia; akofoɔ no nyinaa ntwa ho nhyia prɛko. Saa ara na yɛ no nnansia. Na asɔfoɔ baason nkurakura osebɔ ntotorobɛnto nson mfa nni adaka no anim, na ɛda a ɛtɔ so nson no, montwa kuro no ho nhyia mprɛnson, na asɔfoɔ no nhyɛne ntotorobɛnto no. Na sɛ wɔhyɛne osebɔ abɛn no na mote totorobɛnto no nne a, ɔman no nyinaa nhuro mmɔ ose kɛseɛ, na kuro no ho fasuo no bɛhwe fam tim, na ɔman no mforo nkɔ wɔn anim tee. Na Nun ba Yosua frɛfrɛɛ asɔfoɔ no, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Monsoa apam adaka no, na asɔfoɔ baason nkurakura osebɔ ntotorobɛnto nni AWURADE adaka no anim. Na wɔka kyerɛɛ ɔman no sɛ: Monsene nkɔtwa kuro no ho nhyia, na wɔn a wɔamia no nsene nni AWURADE adaka no anim.
Na Yosua ka kyerɛɛ ɔman no no, asɔfoɔ baason a wɔkurakura osebɔ ntotorobɛnto no sene dii AWURADE anim na wɔhyɛnee ntotorobɛnto no, na AWURADE apam adaka no dii wɔn akyi. Na wɔn a wɔamia no dii asɔfoɔ a wɔhyɛne ntotorobɛnto no anim, na kyidɔm no dii adaka no akyi; wɔnam na wɔrehyɛne ntotorobɛnto no ara. Na ɔman no deɛ, Yosua hyɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Mommmɔ ose, na mommma wɔnnte mo nne, na asɛm biara mmfiri mo anomu de kɔsi da a mɛse mo sɛ mommɔ ose no ansa na moabɔ ose. Na AWURADE adaka no twaa kuro no ho hyiaa prɛko, na wɔbaa nsraban mu bɛdaa hɔ.
Na Yosua sɔree anɔpahema, na asɔfoɔ no soaa AWURADE adaka no. Na asɔfoɔ baason no kurakura osebɔ ntotorobɛnto nson no de di AWURADE adaka no anim, wɔnam na wɔrehyɛne ntotorobɛnto no ara, na wɔn a wɔamia no dii wɔn anim, na kyidɔm no dii AWURADE adaka no akyi, wɔnam na wɔrehyɛne ntotorobɛnto no. Na da a ɛtɔ so mmienu no, wɔtwaa kuro no ho hyiaa prɛko, na wɔsane baa nsraban no mu. Wɔyɛɛ saa nnansia.
Na da a ɛtɔ so nson no, adeɛ rekye pɛ, na wɔtuaa nhema sɔree ntɛm, na wɔtwaa kuro no ho hyiaa saa ara mprɛnson; da no nko ara na wɔtwaa kuro no ho hyiaa mprɛnson. Na ɛbaa sɛ deɛ ɛtɔ so nson no soɔ a asɔfoɔ no rehyɛne ntotorobɛnto no no, Yosua ka kyerɛɛ ɔman no sɛ: Mommɔ ose, ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE de kuro no ama mo. Na kuro no nyɛ ahyiradeɛ, ɛno ne emu ade nyinaa mma AWURADE; odwamamfoɔ Rahab nko ara na ɔnnya nkwa, ɔno ne wɔn a wɔwɔ ne nkyɛn ne ne fie nyinaa, ɛfiri sɛ ɔno na ɔde abɔfoɔ a yɛsomaa wɔn no huntaeɛ. Mo ho yie ara na monhwɛ ahyiradeɛ no ho, na moanhyira so na moamfa ahyiradeɛ no bi, na moamfa Israel nsraban no anyɛ ahyiradeɛ amma amaneɛ amma so. Na dwetɛ ne sika, ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ ne dadeɛ nnoɔma nyinaa nyɛ kronkron mma AWURADE, na wɔmfa mmra AWURADE adekorabea. Ɛnna ɔman no bɔɔ ose na wɔhyɛnee ntotorobɛnto no. Na ɛbaa sɛ ɔman no tee ntotorobɛnto no nne no, ɔman no huro bɔɔ ose kɛseɛ, na ɔfasuo no hwee fam tim, na ɔman no foro kɔɔ kuro no mu, wɔn nyinaa kɔɔ wɔn anim tee, na wɔfaa kuro no. Na wɔde nkrantɛ ano sɛee deɛ ɛwɔ kuro no mu nyinaa pasapasa, mmarima ne mmaa, mmɔfra ne mpanin, anantwie ne nnwan ne mfunumu.
Na mmarima baanu a wɔkɔsraa asase no deɛ, Yosua ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Monkɔ ɔbaa dwamamfoɔ no fie nkɔfa ɔbaa no ne deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa mfiri hɔ, sɛdeɛ mokaa no ntam no. Na mmeranteɛ akwansrafoɔ no kɔe, na wɔde Rahab ne n’agya ne ne na ne ne nuanom ne deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa firi bae, na wɔde n’abusua nyinaa firii adi bɛgyaa wɔn Israel nsraban no akyi. Na kuro no deɛ, wɔde ogya hyee ɛne deɛ ɛwɔ mu nyinaa. Emu dwetɛ ne sika, ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ ne dadeɛ nnoɔma nko na wɔde bɛguu AWURADE fie adekorabea no mu. Na odwamamfoɔ Rahab ne n’agya fie ne deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa deɛ, Yosua gyee wɔn nkwa, na ɔtenaa Israel mu de bɛsi nnɛ, ɛfiri sɛ ɔde abɔfoɔ a Yosua soma maa wɔkɔsraa Yeriko no huntae.
Na Yosua kaa ntam saa berɛ no sɛ:
Nnome nka onipa a ɔbɛsɔre
abɛkyekyere Yeriko kuro yi, AWURADE anim:
Ɔde n’abakan na ɛbɛhyɛ aseɛ,
na ɔde ne ba akumaa na ɛbɛsisi ano apono.
Na AWURADE dii Yosua akyi, na wɔtee ne nka asase no nyinaa so.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
